verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a data-loading library with a managed platform (dltHub), so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention policies, data purging, or deletion controls. The only nearby items are load write behaviors: full-load replace and merge/dedupe. Those are adjacent features that change how data is written, not privacy-oriented retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
